sections.content: How many people are "garage managers and proprietors"?

34,985 people

were counted on the census as "garage managers and proprietors" in England and Wales in March 2021.
Garage managers and proprietors co-ordinate the day-to-day running of garages and specialist vehicle maintenance and repair establishments.

More men than women had this job

Among people working as "garage managers and proprietors" there were more men than women (88.2% compared with 11.8%).

This means "garage managers and proprietors" had a different proportion of men and women compared with the wider occupation group it falls within of "other managers and proprietors".

Men made up 88.2% and women made up 11.8% of "garage managers and proprietors"
Across the whole working population, 52% were men and 48% were women.

Other jobs that had a similar proportion of men and women to "garage managers and proprietors" included:

  • vehicle and parts salespersons and advisers
  • metal working machine operatives
  • vehicle valeters and cleaners

These are the occupations for which the proportion of men and women was most equally split:

  • quality assurance and regulatory professionals
  • chartered and certified accountants
  • conservation professionals

People who had this job were generally older

The occupation of "garage managers and proprietors" had an older age profile compared with the whole working population.

The largest age group of people who had this job were those aged 50 to 54 years. Of the whole working population 11.7% were aged 50 to 54 years. For people working as "garage managers and proprietors", 15.3% were in this age group.

The age group with the smallest proportion of people working as "garage managers and proprietors" was 16 to 19 years.

Other jobs that had a similar age profile to "garage managers and proprietors" included:

  • bus and coach drivers
  • property, housing and estate managers
  • education advisers and school inspectors

Select your age group to see the ten most popular occupations for your age

We can look at who worked as "garage managers and proprietors" by age group and for men and women at the same time to see how these two factors interact.

Men and women with this occupation had a similar age profile, as shown in the chart below.

The percentage of men and women who are "garage managers and proprietors" across age groups

How many people do this job by disability status, employment type and area

Of people working as "garage managers and proprietors", 9.4% were disabled. This means people said they had a long-term condition that limited them "a little" or "a lot" in their day-to-day activities. The average for all occupations is 9.6%.

Disability is more common among people who are older. This occupation had an older age profile compared with the whole working population.

People with this job were more likely to work full-time than part-time (83.5% compared with 16.5%).

They are also more likely to be self-employed (50.4%) than an employee (49.6%).

The region of England and Wales with the highest percentage of people with this job was the South East. At a local level, the areas with the highest percentage of people in this occupation included Cornwall, this is in the region of the South West.
